scope: GTK4 trough and thumb in separate and Motif-hosted preview, including native adjustment/wheel, four semantic states, 1:1 pixels and role-driven palette matrix. No GTK4 arrows were synthesized. Does not claim historical fidelity or manual approval.
limitations: GtkScrollbar has no native steppers/arrows; adapter does not invent them.
Pixels compare GTK renderer output to the translated role-based recipe, not to HP VUE screenshots; this is implementation correctness, not historical approval.
TestYellow is a synthetic test palette; not an installed color scheme.
Coupled preview test uses a private 360x240 Motif host fixture.
dynamic_rerender_note: All four states changed through project reload in both origins. Moving the pointer outside the scrollbar exposes both GTK overlay indicators for the 1:1 capture.
